crossRefs.note: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and…
Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
“This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.
The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered…
Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your…
I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and…
They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and…
I clothed you also with embroidered work, and put sealskin sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered…

translations.web: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”
translations.bsb: Now announce to the people that men and women alike should ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold.”
translations.kjv: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
translations.asv: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let them ask every man of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
